_: It.32: a PAID follower that plugs straight into the VANILLA follower system (recommended over the self-managed follower_paid_spec.json — the user prefers this). Only the recruit trigger + gold are custom; the recruit fragment calls DialogueFollowerScript.SetFollower(akSpeaker), after which vanilla's own trade/wait/follow/dismiss dialogue manages her and follower-manager mods (AFT/EFF/NFF) pick her up automatically. Demonstrates that custom records survive vanilla follower status: she keeps her custom CombatStyle (combat AI is NOT overridden — PlayerFollowerPackage carries no CombatStyle), and a FOLLOWER-ONLY self-introduction topic (gated on CurrentFollowerFaction) shows only after she joins. `coc RiverwoodSleepingGiantInn`, talk to her, pay 500; then 'tell me about yourself' appears, and vanilla wait/trade/dismiss all work.

combatStyles._: A melee-favouring sellsword style — proof that a custom CSTY is preserved through vanilla follower status (the vanilla follow/combat-override packages set no CombatStyle, so the actor's base CSTY drives combat).

npcs.name: Sigrid the Sword
npcs._greeting: Makes her conversable (host quest + Hello). The recruit topic surfaces on top.
npcs.greeting: You look like you could use a blade.
npcs._voiceType: FemaleEvenToned (0x013ADD) — a VoicesFollowerNeutral voice, REQUIRED so vanilla's follow/wait/trade/dismiss dialogue (all GetIsVoiceType-gated) surfaces once SetFollower puts her in CurrentFollowerFaction.
npcs._factions: Only Whiterun crime/citizen (door/gate traversal). NOT in any follower faction at start — SetFollower's alias adds CurrentFollowerFaction at recruit.
npcs._combatStyle: Custom CSTY — preserved while she's a follower. (Add sandbox/travel packages here too for lifelike downtime; they run when she's NOT actively following, i.e. before recruit and after dismiss/while waiting.)

quests._: Hosts the recruit + self-intro topics. StartGameEnabled so they're served when you talk to her.
quests.name: ModForge Vanilla Hire

dialogue._: Recruit line. Shown only when the player can afford it AND has no current follower (GetGlobalValue PlayerFollowerCount==0 — the same global vanilla uses; avoids stomping the single follower slot). Fragment takes gold + DialogueFollowerScript.SetFollower(akSpeaker). After that the line hides (count==1) and vanilla follow/wait/trade/dismiss take over.
dialogue.prompt: Here's 500 gold. Fight at my side.

dialogue._: FOLLOWER-ONLY self-introduction. Gated on GetInFaction CurrentFollowerFaction==1, so it ONLY appears after she's recruited (SetFollower's alias adds that faction) and disappears when dismissed. No fragment — just spoken lines. This is the pattern for any 'unlocked once she travels with you' dialogue (backstory, banter, personal quest hooks).
responses: Sigrid, they call me. Grew up in Markarth's smoke and steel — learned the sword before I could read.
I've sold this blade from Solitude to Riften. You're just the latest to be glad of it.

placements._: Sigrid in the Sleeping Giant Inn common room (any in-room coord; actors snap to navmesh).
